The test image clearly shows:
- White mycelial/fungal growth at the stem crown near soil line
- Stem split open revealing internal browning
- Completely dead plant pulled from sandy soil
- Small dot-like structures (sclerotia) on the white growth

This is textbook **Southern Blight** (*Sclerotium rolfsii*) — the white mycelial mat with mustard-seed sclerotia at the soil line, combined with the stem split showing internal discoloration.
